ownRead.title: Replication and recurrence
ownRead.description: A locked RRG meaning; a definition is not an experimental finding.
ownRead.researchEdition: RRG v0.2.1 repository current; audited companion 2026-10-02; promoted 2026-10-05
ownRead.statement:
## 9. Replication / recurrence

Replication, duplication, autocatalysis, reproduction, aggregation, differentiation, self-assembly, and symmetry breaking are **possible mechanisms of higher-level formation or propagation**, not mandatory steps in the core recursion.

RRG never requires:

\[
A\rightarrow A+A\rightarrow B
\]

at every level.

Biological replication is therefore an example, not the definition of recursion.
ownRead.plainLanguage: Replication is one possible way to form or propagate organization; it is not required at every level.
